items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: Buddy Manning, the same fellows you see on that picture there. He made that banjo himself, you know.

ctx.x: Also they didn't seem to have, like in the old days they had, not far into something, they had the banjo more. Yeah, yeah.

Well I mean, last the band had banjos, and last them had guitars, you know. And when I, when I started coming up, well they was using guitars and banjos, because Buddy Manning, the same fellows you see on that picture there. He made that banjo himself, you know. And it was pretty, pretty, pretty good, you know.
